text:
A product that breaks just after its guarantee ends is likely to be thrown away, and many people feel that warranties should be longer in order to reduce waste. I agree with this view, since longer warranties encourage better products and make repair more common.

To begin with, longer warranties give manufacturers a reason to build durable goods. If a company must repair or replace its products for five years instead of one, it will use stronger parts and better testing, because failures become costly. Products that last longer mean fewer items are made and discarded, which saves energy, water and raw materials. A washing machine with a ten-year guarantee, for example, is likely to be built to last, and its owner does not need to buy a replacement after two years. Over time, durable design would reduce the pile of broken goods that councils must handle.

Furthermore, longer warranties make repair the normal choice. When a fault is covered, customers return the product for repair instead of throwing it away, and companies develop repair services and supply spare parts. Consumers also benefit, since they spend less on replacements. Admittedly, longer guarantees may raise the initial price, and some firms might try to avoid claims. However, honest firms can recover the cost through lower replacement rates and stronger customer loyalty, and governments can set minimum standards and penalise those who refuse legitimate repairs. Clear rules would protect both buyers and sellers, and would make long-lasting products a selling point instead of a rarity.

In conclusion, I agree that warranties should be longer, because this encourages durable design and repair, which reduces waste, provided that clear rules prevent firms from avoiding their responsibilities.

analysis.type_vi: Agree/Disagree: bảo hành dài hơn để giảm rác — agree

plan.think: Mở bằng tình huống quen thuộc (hỏng ngay sau hết bảo hành thì bị vứt) rồi agree + hai lý do (khuyến khích làm đồ bền; sửa chữa thành lựa chọn bình thường).
Nếu công ty phải sửa hoặc thay trong 5 năm thay vì 1 năm họ sẽ dùng linh kiện tốt hơn và kiểm tra kỹ; ít sản phẩm bị làm ra và vứt đi. Ví dụ máy giặt bảo hành 10 năm.

plan.step: 3. Lý do 2 — sửa chữa + nhượng bộ
plan.think: Khi lỗi được bảo hành khách đem sửa; công ty xây dịch vụ và linh kiện thay thế. Nhượng bộ: giá ban đầu tăng và có công ty né tránh yêu cầu; phản bác: thay thế ít hơn, khách trung thành; chính phủ đặt chuẩn tối thiểu.
Agree, với điều kiện luật rõ ràng ngăn công ty né tránh trách nhiệm.
